channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Cloudflare Migrates JavaScript CDN Serving 9B Requests a Day to Its Developer Platform
item.description: Cloudflare has migrated cdnjs, its open source CDN for JavaScript and CSS libraries, to its Developer Platform. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it
item.description: Cloudflare Gateway identifies MCP requests using protocol-level heuristics. Security teams can use that signal to find shadow MCP traffic, enforce Portal-only access for approved servers, and block direct connections on managed network… (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: How to bring your software delivery workflow into GitHub with agent apps
item.description: See how four GitHub agent apps can help you scope, secure, roll out, and ship a feature across the SDLC–all without leaving GitHub. (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Secure all your internal vibe-coded applications — in one click
item.description: Introducing Cloudflare Access for Workers. Attach an Access policy directly to a Worker and it applies everywhere that Worker runs — routes, custom domains, workers.dev, and previews — automatically. (1 source: cloudflare)
